content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes and sells mobile roadway and agricultural machinery, not mining or processing mineral products."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients and additives for formulators, not mined minerals or fertilizers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and industrial components for construction and transportation, not minerals."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Mines and processes salt and sulfate of potash fertilizer, selling deicing salt and farm fertilizer like the target."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Building products, HVAC and industrial fluid components manufactured for contractors, not mining."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes nitrogen fertilizer from natural gas in plants, not mining potash or salt for farm and deicing buyers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, polymers and fibers sold to manufacturers, not mined minerals or fertilizers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Fuel ethanol from corn at one plant, selling through marketers; different feedstock and products."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mines clay sorbents mainly sold as cat litter to consumers and retailers; shares mining but differs in product and customers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Chlor-alkali chemicals and ammunition manufacturing, not potash, salt or fertilizer mining."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Quarries limestone for cement and ready-mix concrete, a different product and construction customer base."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Turf equipment, irrigation and snow throwers manufactured for landscapers and homeowners, not mining."}]}
